key_idea: She puts one tile for each unit of each side, and a square has 4 sides.
steps: Side 1: 1 tile on each of the 4 sides makes 4 tiles.
Side 2: 2 tiles on each of the 4 sides makes 8 tiles.
Side 4: 4 tiles on each of the 4 sides.

choice_feedback.A: 8 tiles is for a square of side 2.
choice_feedback.B: 12 tiles is for a square of side 3.
choice_feedback.D: 4 sides with 4 tiles each make 16, not 18.
choice_feedback.E: 4 sides with 4 tiles each make 16, not 20.
